title: Experiments
intro: Which ranking strategy do buyers actually act on? Every ranking served under an experiment is one exposure; every click, save or dismissal on its results is a verdict. Nothing here is simulated.
failed: The results could not be loaded.
withFeedback: {count, plural, one {# with feedback} other {# with feedback}}

metricHint.clickThroughRate: Share of sessions in which anything shown was acted on.
metricHint.precisionAtK: Over sessions with feedback: share of the top {k} that were acted on.
metricHint.ndcgAtK: Over sessions with feedback: how well the order matched what the reader wanted, 1 being perfect.

notYet: Not enough data to compare the arms yet. Each arm needs at least {minimum} sessions; below that a difference is a story, not a finding.
indistinguishable: The interval includes zero: no difference can be claimed.
gainsIntro: Nobody rates listings; relevance is read from behaviour. These weights are a judgement, published so it can be disagreed with.
